subject: Re: FW: Tenneco: Zion
body:
**Subject:** Following Up on Our Tenneco Collaboration & Next Steps  

Dear Mauricio,  

Thank you again for the opportunity to work together on the Tenneco project — I truly enjoyed our collaboration and your openness throughout the discussions. It’s clear there’s strong alignment between Zion Tech Group’s capabilities and Ziontechgroup’s strategic goals.  

Since we last spoke, we’ve refined our AI/IT services into three focused offerings that could add immediate value:  

1. **Managed AI Support Automation** – Deploy our AI agents to handle Tier-1/2 tickets, reduce response times by up to 60%, and streamline escalations. We’d co-brand this as a seamless extension of your support team.  
2. **AI Readiness & Cost-Optimization Assessments** – Turn the audit framework we discussed into a repeatable, co-branded solution for your clients. We provide technical depth; you lead sales. Revenue split 50/50 on net margin.  
3. **Hybrid-Cloud Migration + AI Ops Pilot** – A 30-day proof-of-concept using your current environment to showcase reduced MTTR and cloud cost savings. Converts to a full MSA/SOW-1 with pre-negotiated terms.  

I’d love to move this forward efficiently. We can refine details via email, or hop on a quick call to align on scope and next steps:  
👉 [Schedule a 30-minute call here](https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup)  

In the meantime, feel free to explore our free tools and services at [ziontechgroup.com](https://ziontechgroup.com) — many teams find them useful for benchmarking and planning.  

Looking forward to your thoughts on which direction makes the most sense to pursue.  

Warm regards,  
**Kleber Garcia Alcatrão**  
CEO, Zion Tech Group  
[ziontechgroup.com](https://ziontechgroup.com)  
kleber@ziontechgroup.com | +1 302 464 0950
